faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 08 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Minimum Second Class or equivalent CGPA in a three-year General Nursing and Midwife (GNM) Course to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Nurse-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Nurse-II post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per ICMR Guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse-II job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Nurse-II position in this recruitment drive by AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Nurse-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Application Review. Shortlisted candidates will be further notified.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The terms and duration of the contract will be as per the project requirements and AIIMS Delhi policies.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: The salary details for the Project Nurse-II position are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for this information.
